newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent down in late trading, seeks IPE support.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent down in late trading, seeks IPE support.

text.p: September Brent futures were softer in late trading on Tuesday, although traders were expecting the market to see some support when London opens.
September Brent last traded at $19.36 per barrel on SIMEX, 10 cents per barrel lower from the London close of 19.46.
But traders said there was still more interest in buying rather than selling.
On NYMEX, September crudes last traded at $20.61, down 14 cents from New York, which had closed at $20.75.
